description_en: Queries the configurations of Server Load Balancer (SLB) instances for an application
name: DescribeApplicationSlbs

Code.description_en:
The HTTP status code. Valid values:

`2xx`: The request is successful.

`3xx`: The request is redirected.

`4xx`: A client error occurs.

`5xx`: A server error occurs
Code.description_zh:
接口状态或POP错误码。取值说明如下：

2xx：成功。
3xx：重定向。
4xx：请求错误。
5xx：服务器错误

Internet.description_en: The configurations of the Internet-facing SLB instance

items.description_en: The details of the configuration of the Internet-facing SLB instance

Cookie.description_en:
The cookie that is configured on the server.

The cookie must be 1 to 200 characters in length and can contain only ASCII letters and digits. It cannot contain commas (,), semicolons (;), or spaces. It cannot start with a dollar sign ($).

This parameter is required when `StickySession` is set to `true` and `StickySessionType` is set to `server`
Cookie.description_zh:
服务器上配置的Cookie。

长度为1~200个字符，只能包含ASCII英文字母和数字字符，不能包含半角逗号（,）、半角分号（;）或空格，不能以$开头。

当StickySession为on且StickySessionType为server时，该参数必选且有效

CookieTimeout.description_en:
The cookie timeout period. Unit: seconds. Valid values: `1` to `86400`.

This parameter is required when `StickySession` is set to `true` and `StickySessionType` is set to `insert`
CookieTimeout.description_zh:
Cookie超时时间。单位：秒。取值范围：1~86400。

当StickySession为on且StickySessionType为insert时，该参数必选且有效

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the rule was created. This value is a UNIX timestamp

HttpsCaCertId.description_en: The ID of the CA certificate for the HTTPS protocol
HttpsCaCertId.description_zh: HTTPS协议对应的阿里云CA证书ID

HttpsCertId.description_en: The ID of the certificate for the HTTPS protocol
HttpsCertId.description_zh: HTTPS协议对应的阿里云证书ID

Port.description_en: The listening port of the SLB instance

StickySession.description_en: Indicates whether session persistence is enabled

StickySessionType.description_en:
The cookie handling method. Valid values:

`insert`: inserts a cookie. When a client makes the first request, the SLB instance inserts a cookie into the response. The next request from the client contains the cookie, and the SLB instance forwards the request to the same backend server.

`server`: rewrites a cookie. When the SLB instance detects a user-defined cookie, it rewrites the cookie. The next request from the client contains the new cookie, and the SLB instance forwards the request to the same backend server.

This parameter is required when `StickySession` is set to `true`
StickySessionType.description_zh:
Cookie处理方式。取值：

insert：植入Cookie。客户端第一次访问时，负载均衡会在返回请求中植入Cookie，下次客户端携带此Cookie访问，负载均衡服务会将请求定向转发给之前记录到的后端服务器上。

server：重写Cookie。负载均衡发现用户自定义了Cookie，将会对原来的Cookie进行重写，下次客户端携带新的Cookie访问，负载均衡服务会将请求定向转发给之前记录到的后端服务器。

当StickySession值为on时，该参数必选且有效

InternetSlbChargeType.description_zh: 公网负载均衡的计费方式

InternetSlbExpired.description_en: Indicates whether the Internet-facing SLB instance has expired

InternetSlbId.description_en: The ID of the Internet-facing SLB instance

The error code.

This parameter is not returned if the request is successful.

This parameter is returned if the request fails. For more information, see the Error codes section in this topic

If the request is successful, `success` is returned.

If the request fails, a specific error code is returned
